note: Household portion weights used to turn the answer key's amounts into grams. Every value is copied from USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy (April 2018 release, data/raw/usda/FoodData_Central_sr_legacy_food_csv_2018-04.zip, food_portion.csv) for the fdc_id shown. Weight units (lb, oz, g, kg) and volume units (ml, l, fl oz) are converted in build_key.py, not here.
